how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-tirisfal-glades-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:98601:title: A Difficult Path
rows.quest:98601:obj:0: Read the ⟦E1⟧ and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.
rows.quest:98601:details:0: While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine its of some importance to a paladin like yourself.
rows.quest:98601:details:1: Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
rows.quest:90902:title: Rediscovering the Light
rows.quest:90902:details:0: I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to ⟦E5⟧ yourself or others.
rows.quest:90902:details:1: The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
rows.quest:90902:progress:0: Mastery of the light will return, in time.
rows.quest:91208:title: Coming to Terms
rows.quest:91208:details:0: Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.
rows.quest:91208:details:1: These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
rows.quest:91208:progress:0: Coming to terms with this new life is not easy for any of us. For some it's simply more than they can bear.
rows.quest:91209:title: Continue Your Training
rows.quest:91209:obj:0: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of ⟦E7⟧. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
rows.quest:91209:details:0: Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of ⟦E7⟧ in central ⟦E8⟧. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training.
rows.quest:91209:details:1: One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through ⟦E9⟧ lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
rows.quest:98389:title: A Light in the Darkness
rows.quest:98389:obj:0: Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
rows.quest:98389:details:0: If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.
rows.quest:98389:details:1: This we have in common with all ⟦E9⟧--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own ⟦E10⟧ us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.
rows.quest:98389:details:2: In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
rows.quest:98389:details:3: Then they will see our nature.
rows.quest:98389:progress:0: Have you freed the poor, unfortunate souls trapped in that cave?
rows.quest:410:title: The Dormant Shade
rows.quest:410:progress:0: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
rows.quest:410:completion:0: You place the ⟦E11⟧ upon the table and light it...
rows.quest:431:title: Candles of Beckoning
rows.quest:431:completion:0: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.
rows.quest:5481:obj:0: Collect 3 ⟦E12⟧ and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the ⟦E7⟧ graveyard.
rows.quest:5481:details:0: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.
rows.quest:5481:details:1: When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in ⟦E7⟧ graveyard.
rows.quest:5481:progress:0: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
rows.quest:5481:completion:0: What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.
rows.quest:5481:completion:1: Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... doom weed!
rows.quest:367:obj:0: Apothecary Johaan in the town of ⟦E7⟧ wants you to collect 5 Vials of ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:367:details:0: Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to ⟦E14⟧'s demise. She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on ⟦E15⟧. This new disease will bring ⟦E14⟧'s Scourge Army to ruin.
rows.quest:367:details:1: My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
rows.quest:367:progress:0: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, ⟦1⟧? Time is fleeting!
rows.quest:367:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦2⟧ and I thank you for your efforts.
rows.quest:404:obj:0: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:404:details:0: Scourge have trickled into ⟦E8⟧ and have infested the area west of ⟦E7⟧, near the old bridge.
rows.quest:404:details:1: Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find. Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.
rows.quest:404:progress:0: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
rows.quest:404:completion:0: Well done. I regret not being there to see you smash those ⟦E16⟧ into rotting pulp!
rows.quest:5482:obj:0: Collect 10 ⟦E17⟧ and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.⟦3⟧
rows.quest:5482:details:0: So you can see the predicament that I'm in, ⟦4⟧. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.
rows.quest:5482:details:1: It is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the ⟦E7⟧ graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.
rows.quest:5482:progress:0: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
rows.quest:5482:completion:1: B<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>
rows.quest:5482:completion:2: These will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today ⟦5⟧. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
rows.quest:97558:title: Hides for the ⟦E9⟧
rows.quest:97558:obj:0: Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 ⟦E18⟧ Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:97558:details:0: One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an ⟦E16⟧ ⟦E5⟧ itself?
rows.quest:97558:details:2: Ours is a cursed life, . We must take from the living to further our own existence.
rows.quest:97558:details:3: When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!
rows.quest:97558:details:4: Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
rows.quest:97558:progress:0: Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.
rows.quest:97558:progress:1: It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.
rows.quest:97558:progress:2: Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
rows.quest:361:obj:0: Find Yvette Farthing, and deliver to her the letter from Thurman Agamand.
rows.quest:361:details:0: This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand. It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...
rows.quest:361:completion:0: Oh...my poor Thurman! I begged him to leave Agamand Mills with me and my father, but his family loyalty was too strong! And I knew it! I just knew it that Brand meant him harm!! Oh, ⟦E22⟧ this Plague, and the Scourge!
rows.quest:361:completion:1: B<Yvette's face then smoothes and grows cold.>
rows.quest:361:completion:2: But regrets are for the weak. As a ⟦E9⟧, I have new goals and love is not one of them. I would thank you for delivering this letter, for I had wondered what happened to my past love.
rows.quest:361:completion:3: But that life is over. Forever.
rows.quest:365:obj:0: Steal 10 pumpkins from the farm to the west, just north of Deathknell and take them to Apothecary Johaan in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:365:details:0: What have we here? You look like a fledgling ⟦6⟧. If you hope to prove yourself to The Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of The ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:365:details:1: To the west you'll find a farm. ⟦E23⟧ infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse. And worse yet, the ⟦E24⟧ patrols ⟦E25⟧ from their tower. Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.
rows.quest:365:details:2: Once you have 10, take them to Apothecary Johaan in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:365:progress:0: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents. Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, ⟦7⟧?
rows.quest:365:completion:0: You have performed your bidding well, young ⟦8⟧. You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to The Dark Lady's army.
rows.quest:374:obj:0: Bring 10 ⟦E26⟧ Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:374:details:0: Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing ⟦E26⟧ Crusaders. ⟦E8⟧ is crawling with them.
rows.quest:374:details:1: Varimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of ⟦E15⟧, the ⟦E27⟧ race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in ⟦E8⟧ we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: ⟦E28⟧.
rows.quest:374:details:2: Venture forth and wage an offensive on the ⟦E24⟧, ⟦9⟧. Bring me back 10 ⟦E26⟧ Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
rows.quest:374:progress:0: Have you collected 10 ⟦E26⟧ Insignia Rings yet, ⟦10⟧?
rows.quest:374:completion:0: Varimathras would be proud. You serve your leaders well, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:407:obj:0: Take the ⟦E29⟧ to the Captured ⟦E26⟧ Zealot who is being held in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.
rows.quest:407:details:0: Harmless pumpkins, right? Or so it would seem. If we are to defeat ⟦E14⟧'s advances from the North and the ⟦E27⟧ infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.
rows.quest:407:details:1: With a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady. This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.
rows.quest:407:details:2: Yet another ⟦E26⟧ Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern. Take this pumpkin to the fool.
rows.quest:407:progress:0: Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  ⟦E28⟧ shall rid ⟦E15⟧ of your. . .⟦12⟧⟦13⟧. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
rows.quest:407:completion:0: By the Light! Finally some food! Sweet, sweet pumpkin. . . .
rows.quest:99144:title: Seeking Refuge
rows.quest:99144:obj:0: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:99144:obj:1: * Escore Bareth Dawnstone out of Crusader's Outpost
rows.quest:99144:details:0: Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in ⟦E7⟧ when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!
rows.quest:99144:details:1: I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
rows.quest:358:obj:0: Kill Rot Hide ⟦E30⟧ and Rot Hide Mongrels.
rows.quest:358:obj:1: Bring 8 Embalming Ichors to Magistrate Sevren in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:358:details:0: The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.
rows.quest:358:details:1: The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies. This cannot be allowed!
rows.quest:358:details:2: Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the ⟦E31⟧ that gives them life.
rows.quest:358:progress:0: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
rows.quest:358:completion:0: Expertly done, ⟦14⟧. The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries. It may have secrets we can use against them.
rows.quest:358:completion:1: As I said, well done. But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:366:obj:0: Return ⟦E32⟧ to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.
rows.quest:366:details:0: Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer ⟦E33⟧, were friends and students within the Kirin ⟦E34⟧ - a society of mages in ⟦E35⟧.
rows.quest:366:details:1: Gunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King. It is good to know he is free.
rows.quest:366:details:2: We must have him. I have placed a ⟦E36⟧ on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King. After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.
rows.quest:366:progress:0: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!
rows.quest:366:completion:0: My book?!? So you were the thief who stole it!
rows.quest:366:completion:1: But...what is this new enchantment upon it...Bethor? He is in Lordaeron?
rows.quest:366:completion:2: If he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...
rows.quest:375:obj:0: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some ⟦E37⟧ to Gretchen Dedmar in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:375:details:0: It's so cold, now. The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent. The Mindless State will be upon me soon. But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady. When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.
rows.quest:375:details:1: Now my hands shake from the chill. If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some ⟦E37⟧ I could sew myself a blanket. Help me, ⟦15⟧, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
rows.quest:375:progress:0: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some ⟦E37⟧ yet, ⟦16⟧?
rows.quest:375:completion:0: I appreciate your efforts, ⟦17⟧. May Slyvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .
rows.quest:405:obj:0: Present ⟦E38⟧ to Bethor Iceshard in the ⟦E39⟧.
rows.quest:405:details:0: Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the ⟦E39⟧ to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge. You, ⟦18⟧, will be that agent.
rows.quest:405:details:1: Present these orders to Bethor. He will then instruct you on your mission. I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich. And it will be dangerous.
rows.quest:405:details:2: So ready yourself, ⟦19⟧. You must not fail.
rows.quest:405:details:3: You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the ⟦E39⟧.
rows.quest:405:progress:0: Greetings. Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.⟦20⟧⟦21⟧Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
rows.quest:405:completion:0: Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren. Then yes, your business with me is crucial.
rows.quest:405:completion:1: I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
rows.quest:426:obj:0: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:426:details:0: The Scourge are trying to ⟦E40⟧ a base at the Agamand Mills. If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.
rows.quest:426:details:1: The orders have been given. The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.
rows.quest:426:details:2: Go to the Mills. Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.
rows.quest:426:details:3: To get to the Mills, follow the road west. After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north. When you see windmills, the ⟦E41⟧ will begin.
rows.quest:426:progress:0: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, ⟦22⟧. Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless ⟦E16⟧ back into the ⟦E42⟧!
rows.quest:426:completion:0: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, ⟦23⟧. I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.
rows.quest:427:obj:0: Executor Zygand of ⟦E7⟧ wants you to kill 10 ⟦E26⟧ Warriors.
rows.quest:427:details:0: The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our ⟦E41⟧ with the wretched ⟦E24⟧. We now know their exact locations throughout ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:427:details:1: But the Deathguard has larger concerns. The Lich King's army grows in number each night. We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the ⟦E24⟧ to the grave.
rows.quest:427:details:2: Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 ⟦E26⟧ Warriors.
rows.quest:427:progress:0: If you wish to prove your worth to The Dark Lady, slay 10 ⟦E26⟧ Warriors, ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:427:completion:0: Most excellent, ⟦25⟧. Your skill in the art of ⟦E43⟧ is undeniable.
rows.quest:359:details:0: I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.
rows.quest:359:details:1: I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal. Our vigilance on the border to the ⟦E42⟧ must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!
rows.quest:359:details:2: ⟦E44⟧ south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation. Speak with Deathguard Linnea. She has the information I need.
rows.quest:359:completion:0: Magistrate Sevren wants a report? Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.
rows.quest:359:completion:1: We have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.
rows.quest:360:details:0: Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you. He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.
rows.quest:360:details:1: And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
rows.quest:360:completion:0: It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.
rows.quest:360:completion:1: But we will not give in. He will not take us again!
rows.quest:368:obj:0: Apothecary Johaan of the town of ⟦E7⟧ needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:368:details:0: While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.
rows.quest:368:details:1: I will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity. You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.
rows.quest:368:progress:0: ⟦26⟧, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
rows.quest:368:completion:0: The scales are perfect, ⟦27⟧. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.
rows.quest:370:obj:0: Executor Zygand in ⟦E7⟧ wants you to kill Captain Perrine, 3 ⟦E26⟧ Zealots and 3 ⟦E26⟧ Missionaries.
rows.quest:370:details:0: The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands. According to the information, ⟦E28⟧ has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:370:details:1: Kill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.
rows.quest:370:progress:0: Young ⟦28⟧, you shouldn't be wasting your time here in ⟦E7⟧ when your people need you fighting for their cause. Now, take up arms and travel to the southwest, to the ruined tower, and slay Captain Perrine along with 3 ⟦E26⟧ Zealots and 3 ⟦E26⟧ Missionaries. We shall herd the ⟦E24⟧ like cattle to their demise.
rows.quest:370:completion:0: Captain Perrine's death will undoubtedly please The Dark Lady. You have performed your duty well, ⟦29⟧.
rows.quest:355:details:0: You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge. But the Agamand Mills hold a ⟦E45⟧ to all the ⟦E9⟧, not just to me.
rows.quest:355:details:1: I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.
rows.quest:355:completion:0: Coleman speaks well of you, ⟦30⟧, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.
rows.quest:355:completion:1: The ⟦E9⟧ have need of your talents once again...
rows.quest:362:obj:0: Slay Devlin Agamand, and bring ⟦E46⟧ to Coleman Farthing in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:362:details:0: Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different. Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.
rows.quest:362:details:1: When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb. His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.
rows.quest:362:details:2: I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin. Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
rows.quest:362:completion:0: Thank you. Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.
rows.quest:362:completion:1: If my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed. They failed me and my family when the Plague came - now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!
rows.quest:371:obj:0: Executor Zygand in ⟦E7⟧ has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 ⟦E26⟧ Friars.
rows.quest:371:details:0: We are still at war and the ⟦E24⟧ grows in strength. The report Executor Arren sent me indicates ⟦E26⟧ Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.
rows.quest:371:details:1: Kill Vachon along with 5 ⟦E26⟧ Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
rows.quest:371:progress:0: I see you have returned but your task is not complete. Perhaps you are at ease with the mere humans interfering with The Dark Lady's plan? Or perhaps you can heed the call of duty and slay Captain Vachon and his band of ⟦E26⟧ Friars!
rows.quest:371:completion:0: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the ⟦E24⟧'s advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit. But other threats loom.
